#259 · Mud Fish Pokémon

Marshtomp

Water Ground

Hoenn · Generation 3

Marshtomp is a Water/Ground-type Mud Fish Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 28 kg. It evolves from Mudkip and into Swampert. Its highest base stat is Attack (85), with a base stat total of 405.
